name: sequence-suppression
description: One do-not-contact entry of one space (backlog:b6f8a6504a24): a domain or a contact the space never sends to. While an entry is active, no sequence step for it forms a proposal — the sweep refuses the step row-locally with the entry's reason. Removal keeps the row (status removed) so the audit keeps who listed and who unlisted. (backlog:b6f8a6504a24)
